expected_issues.title: Abstract method added to a public interface breaks custom implementations
expected_issues.description: SingletonBeanRegistry is a public interface that third-party registries implement. Adding an abstract method in a minor release breaks their compilation; a default method (for example throwing UnsupportedOperationException) or documenting the break would avoid it.
